summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no changes made):** The auth → watchlist chain actually looks correctly wired in current `master`: - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request (cookies go out). - Login/signup (`db/auth.ts`) always resolves to the same stable `user_id` per email (not a fresh id per session), so re-login reattaches to the same account. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own `use("*", ...)` middleware requiring a valid session and setting `X-User-Id`; every query and mutation filt
